senses.gloss: Khara, a Rākshasa, son of Viśravas. § 526 (Rāmopākhyānap.): III, 275, 15896 (Rākā bore Kh. and Śūrpaṇakhā from Viśravas), 15900 (proficient in archery and hostile to the brahmans), 15907 (Kh. and Śūrpaṇakhā attended on Rāvaṇa and Vibhīshaṇa while they were practising austerities).-§ 528 (do.): III, 277, 15986 (his hostilities with Rāma Dāśarathi on account of Śūrpaṇakhā), 15988 (Rāma slew Kh. and Dūshaṇa), 15996.--§ 537 (Rāma-Rāvaṇayuddha): III, 285, 16365 (the same(?), in the army of Rāvaṇa).--§ 599 (Jayadrathavadhap.): VII, 107, 4040 (yathā Dāśarathī Rāmaḥ Khºṃ hatvā mahābalaṃ, cf. § 528)
